Original and selected retain 104 external targets in the same order. Against the inherited 2440-byte linked NM function, only eight halfwords at offsets 0x48, 0x4E, 0x50, 0x52, 0x58, 0x5C, 0x5E and 0x60 change in the initial stage-save block; every other linked function byte is identical.
